svg.title: Sentinel — Financial Intelligence Agent
svg.desc: Sentinel: LangGraph agent that parses SEC filings and raises risk alerts, using local embeddings on ChromaDB + FAISS to cut inference API cost to zero. 150ms filing parse; <7s risk alerts; $0 inference API. Recognition: Rank 14 / 2,200+ · Iit Madras. Tech: LangGraph, ChromaDB, FAISS, FastAPI.
